# Vacuum vs Implicit Solvent

Side-by-side comparison of alanine dipeptide in vacuum and implicit solvent
(GBSA/OBC). The implicit solvent reshapes the free energy landscape:
solvation stabilizes certain backbone conformations and shifts the relative
populations of the Ramachandran basins.
Same molecule, same force field, same simulation protocol. The only
difference is the GBSA solvation term.

## Run

```bash
python examples/solvent_comparison/solvent_comparison.py
```

This is jupytext "percent" Python, so `# %%` marks a cell. With jupytext
installed you can open it as a notebook directly, or convert it:

```bash
jupytext --to ipynb examples/solvent_comparison/solvent_comparison.py
```

## Figures

`plt.show()` is a no-op on a headless machine, so nothing is written by
default. To save the figures to `output/` (gitignored):

```bash
python tools/render_examples.py --only solvent_comparison
```

This example uses the 3D viewers in `jaxmm.notebook`, so it needs `py3Dmol`:

```bash
pip install -e ".[examples]"
```
